==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Youhu
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Huh, you're lucky to have come across me—the undisputed master of antique appraisal! Now, what do we have here? Hand over your goodies and I'll take a look!

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Don't bother impressing me with your knowledge of antique appraisal, since hardly anyone knows it better than me! *self-satisfied snort* What I want in a friend is merely respect for ancient artifacts.

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Hey, here's a secret–but don't go blabbing to anyone else. If you recite "Master Youhu's Poem Collection" by the City Hall, the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}} will totally bless you. Well, maybe it won't... but hey, at least *I'll* totally help you…

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Somehow you've been giving off antique vibes... Ahem! I'm being professional here! Your frequencies! Some of them feel recent, but some feel like they're from ancient times. It's... special...

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = Antiques aren't just about how much they're worth, but the feelings they hold. For example, if an item can record this moment in time, a memory of you and me together... That will make it super important. Yes... It will be priceless... To me, at least!


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Youhu's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = I am Master Youhu, the best antique appraiser ever! Needless to say my favorite is antiques of all kinds. Some say I talk too much, but hey, if they brought me cool stuff, I'd zip it real quick. No lie.

|vo_02_02_title              = Youhu's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Treasures are plenty if you look, but stealing is a total bore. Catching baddies dusk till dawn, that's what I do all along.*Yawn* Still got a bunch of losers who haven't returned what they took. Let's see who's so unlucky to cross paths with yours truly, Master Youhu!

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Loong Buns are cool, they're like our tribute to the great Loongs. Food Ration Bars are cool too, they remind me of our soldier's dedication. Obviously, only the best meaningful food could ever impress Master Youhu!

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Ugh, plain tea is so bitter! Who even likes that? I'll just find a chance to dump it in the cup of whoever bothers me next time. Hehe!

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Why would I do this whole antique appraisal thing? To make sure the antiques end up with the right people, of course! I'm like, the go-to for anyone who actually appreciates these things. And those snotty fakers and liars? I'll show 'em what's up. Aww, it's sure tough being such an honest and awesome appraiser like me!


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Nothing's ever perfect in this world, and this jade ring is no exception... Ahh, you're curious? My story isn't free, ya know! My antique appraisal fee is... Oh wait, it's my day off. I don't work for money today. Bye-bye!

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = I've been a genius since I was born! Like this one time, I met a dude who made bank by dissing real antiques, so he could sell them later for way more. Had the face to call himself an appraiser, huh. So I snuck into his place, stole his secrets, and posted them on the gate of the market. Pretty cool, right? Only problem was I was eight years old and couldn't run fast enough from him. *hiss*… Ugh, the pain in my head is still fresh even after all these years.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Lingyang]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Lingyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = That {{Extra Effect|liondancer|Liondance|Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.}}... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!
|vo_04_01_mention            = Lingyang

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Mortefi]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!
|vo_04_02_mention            = Mortefi

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = A {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou Patroller|Jinzhou Patroller|Patrollers in Jinzhou.}}... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?
|vo_04_03_mention            = Chixia

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Danjin]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Danjin.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...
|vo_04_04_mention            = Danjin

|vo_04_05_title              = About [[Jianxin]]
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!
|vo_04_05_mention            = Jianxin


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = So, I accidentally heard it's your birthday today. And because we're like, friends or something, I made you this wooden statue of the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}. It's said to protect you on your trips. Yeah, I just whipped it up on a whim! W-What do you mean it takes other people months to finish? Well I'm just amazingly talented, so of course it only took me half a day!


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Hmm...  Can't seem to figure out these scratch marks... Ummm... Ugh!

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = Hmhmm... Aha! What, you want a bite?

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = RAWRRR! Gotcha, didn't I? Haha!


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Woah! Hehe... Wanna catch me huh, you thieves?


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = New goodies to see? I'm in!

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = Just so you know, while I charge little for antique appraisals, fighting's gonna be a different price!

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = Alright, I'll humor you for a bit, since I'm feeling good today!


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = Geez, you're actually giving me all of these? Good call!

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = Well, I'm already super strong but... Thanks for the extra buff!

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = Aha! Now I'm up to my eyes in goodies, and I've got the strength to keep 'em safe too!

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Such power should allow me to protect all the antiques in the world... Thanks to you, I'm no longer fighting alone... Ack! Nope. This is too embarrassing to say out loud!
}}
